newsitem.title: USA: Nevada Manhattan in timberland venture.
newsitem.headline: Nevada Manhattan in timberland venture.

text.p: Nevada Manhattan Mining Inc said Thursday its subsidiary, Equatorial Resources, has entered into a joint venture agreement with Jonasa Corp regarding the ownership and operation of 278,000 hectares, or 695,000 acres, of virgin timberland in Brazil.

Under the agreement, Equatorial Resources will manage the property and will earn a 50 percent interest in all operations, including timber harvesting and milling activities currently being conducted on the property, the company said.
No further details of the deal were disclosed.
The company, which owns 80 percent of Equatorial Resources, said the timberland is in the state of Para which is in the Amazon Basin of Brazil.
